top_signals.title: Iraq to Sign Agreement with Syria on Building of Oil Pipelines
top_signals.summary: Iraq will sign an agreement with Syria on the construction of pipelines linking oil production sites to global export markets via the Mediterranean, according to a statement.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
